subject: money-and-currency
detail: Spendly stores amount_cents (integer cents) with no currency; Tallyho stores amount plus currency (shown with decimals, e.g. 12.40 GBP, type undocumented) and converts foreign receipts to a home currency. A budget's 'spent of limit' is shown in one currency. Summing mixed currencies or mixing decimal and integer amounts would give wrong totals.
solutions: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency on every expense and budget; an expense in a budget must be in the budget's currency; conversion deferred (M02)
Integer minor units plus currency, and build conversion now with an exchange-rate provider
Decimal amounts with currency
recommended: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency everywhere; an expense added to a budget must match the budget's currency (the scan review asks for the amount in the budget's currency when the receipt differs); conversion stays deferred

subject: removed-member-expenses
detail: The user saw a removed member's earlier expenses stay in the budget (my-notes.md:2) and did not say whether that is wanted. Whether the removed member can still see them is unknown. Getting this wrong either changes budget totals retroactively or leaks budget data to someone who was removed.
solutions: Keep the expenses in the budget, mark them 'former member', revoke the removed member's access to the whole budget, and tell the owner before removing
Move the removed member's expenses out of the budget into their personal expenses
Ask the owner at removal time which of the two to do
recommended: Keep the expenses in the budget (totals stay right, matching Tallyho), mark them as from a former member, revoke all access for the removed member, and show the owner a confirmation that explains this; offering a choice can come later if the user wants it

subject: category-on-scanned-expenses
detail: Spendly requires one of four categories on every expense; Tallyho's scan fills only merchant, date and total, so a scanned expense has no category from the scan.
solutions: Category is a required choice on the scan review screen, no default
Default scanned expenses to 'other'
Guess the category from the merchant
recommended: Required choice on the review screen with no default, so 'other' does not fill up silently; a merchant-based suggestion can come later

subject: scanned-date-trust
detail: Tallyho's scanned date is often wrong (user's notes); saving it unchecked would put expenses in the wrong month and so the wrong budget period (M07).
solutions: Mark the scanned date for checking and require confirmation; replace missing or implausible dates with today, flagged
Ignore the scanned date and always use today
Trust the scanned date
recommended: Mark it for checking and require confirmation; implausible (future or more than 90 days old) or missing dates become today, flagged

subject: personal-vs-budget-expenses
detail: Spendly expenses belong to no one and no budget; Tallyho expenses are listed per budget. The unified app must say where an expense lives and who sees it.
solutions: Every expense has an author; budget is optional; without a budget only the author sees it
Every expense must be in a budget; each user gets a personal budget
recommended: Author required, budget optional; a personal expense is visible to its author only

subject: monthly-reset-semantics
detail: Tallyho documents only that budgets 'reset monthly'; day, time zone, rollover and whether expenses are kept are unknown.
solutions: Spent total covers the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; expenses kept; no rollover; computed at read time
Reset on the budget's creation day each month
Scheduled job that archives and zeroes
recommended: Calendar month in the budget's time zone, expenses kept, no rollover, computed at read time

subject: invitation-rules
detail: Tallyho does not document who may invite, expiry or reuse of invitations; a reusable or non-expiring link would let anyone holding it join a budget and see its expenses.
solutions: Owner-only invites, single-use token, 7-day expiry, accepted only by an account with the invited email
Any member may invite
recommended: Owner-only, single-use, 7-day expiry, bound to the invited email

subject: receipt-images
detail: Receipt photos are personal data (may show card digits, addresses); Tallyho's storage and retention are unknown, and sending them to an OCR provider is a data transfer.
solutions: Private object storage, access through the expense's permission check, delete with the expense; OCR provider chosen by the user with a no-retention option, or on-device/self-hosted OCR
Do not keep images after extraction
recommended: Private storage behind the expense's permission check, deleted with the expense; OCR provider is the user's choice behind an adapter (decided at implementation, needs their account and keys)
